title: The Flame of the Spirit Tortoise
text: “We’ve suddenly ended up fighting a really tough opponent, haven’t we…? If we take them down, we’ll probably get a decent reward…”
The panda beastman speaks with a sense of resignation. He seems a little hesitant, though.
“No matter who the opponent is, Sakura, I’ll do my best. I’ll protect Mel-chan, too.”
“Sakura-chan… You’re right! Let’s go. To minimize the damage as much as possible.”
“What about Luna? Can you protect Keel-kun?”
“We’ve got plenty of people, so Luna-chan, you should stay with Keel.”
“Yay!”
Luna-chan hugs Keel.
“Whoa! Stop it!”
“Are you scared, Keel-kun? It’s okay, Luna will fight in your place.”
“I-I’m fine! I’m part of my big brother’s team, too!”
Rival dives down with his Assistant and lands right next to my Father.
“Gaelion, do your best too!”
“Me too…”
The Rival and his Assistant are showing their determination as well. We can’t afford to lose now. Gripping my spear tightly, I say:
“Alright, here we go!”

“Yeah! First, Motoyasu and I will crush its head to hold it off. While we’re doing that, Melty, Keel, and Wyndia, head for the cave in the mountain on its back. Once you’re inside, give me a signal, and I’ll follow you.”
“‘Yes (of course)!’”
“Yuki-chan and Filolial-sama, please cast Cooperative Magic from the rear. I suspect the Spirit Tortoise will unleash a powerful breath attack from its head, so please be extremely careful.”
“Understood! Now then, everyone, let the battle begin!”
“All right! Let’s put the plan into action!”
At Father’s command, we rushed toward the Spirit Tortoise.
“Brionac X!”

The moment we encountered it, I unleashed a full-power Brionac at the Spirit Tortoise. I’d hoped this would pierce both its head and its heart, but the shell was unnaturally hard, and I couldn’t break through it.
“Oh… its head’s been blown off.”

My Father stood there dumbfounded at the sight. The Spirit Tortoise nearly collapsed with a thud, but it immediately regenerated its head and fired a bolt of lightning at us. Father stepped forward and raised his shield. Faced with his formidable Defense Power, the bolt had no chance and was completely nullified.
“Ugh… my SP’s been drained… even though I did apply the Absorption Reduction buff.”

Father’s shield is spewing smoke. It’s not that he can’t withstand it, but he looks a bit strained. The Spirit Tortoise’s head fires another breath attack. Father withstands this one as well, but a stray shot flew off toward our rear as it was fired. It looks like the town behind us has sustained some damage.
“Guh… Wait, does this mean as long as I keep holding out and Motoyasu-kun keeps attacking, it’ll keep spewing that breath indefinitely…?”
“That’s right. But we can’t just leave it alone.”
“…You’re right.”

From behind, Yuki-chan and the others’ Cooperative Magic strikes the Spirit Tortoise. I think it was ‘Tornado,’ wasn’t it? Thanks to Yuki-chan and the others’ fully enhanced magic, the Spirit Tortoise’s head and limbs are being torn to shreds.

Then, the Spirit Tortoise locks onto Yuki-chan and the others as its target. Thanks to Filolial-sama and the others’ swift feet, we quickly scatter to avoid the breath attack, and in the meantime, I launch an attack to avert disaster. While we’re in a position to fight, we need to buy time to wait for Keel and the others to swiftly infiltrate the Spirit Tortoise’s body.
“Hm?”
The Spirit Tortoise’s breath attack… has changed. It’s spewing radial flames. Has it ever used an attack like this before? It looks like it’s slightly enveloped in flames, doesn’t it?
“Whoa!”
Father endures it, but flames are wrapping around him. In the blink of an eye, the fire intensifies and spreads across his entire body.
“Ouch! It’s hot!”
As my Father rolls around, I cast “Fire Erase” to dispel the flames.
“That attack from earlier was a status effect. Since I’ve completely nullified it, it’s trying to chip away at my HP with status effects!”
“This is a pain… I’ll crush its head before it can breathe fire.”

With that, I unleashed a barrage of attack skills—like Brionac and Gungnir—along with normal attacks, timing them to avoid cooldowns and prevent the Spirit Tortoise from counterattacking. However, this time, it started firing breath attacks just before its head would regenerate from its shell.

You see, since breath attacks pass through the throat to be expelled, it wasn’t entirely impossible. To destroy the main body, you have to destroy its insides. After a while of this back-and-forth, flames shot up from the mountain on the Spirit Tortoise’s back. It seems Rival gave the signal just as we’d planned.
“In this state, wouldn’t it be dangerous for me to go in…?”
“It’ll be fine. I, Motoyasu, may not be as tough as my Father, but I can handle it.”
If I can even deflect Takt’s special attack, the Spirit Tortoise’s breath attack is no problem at all.
“Really? Well then, Motoyasu, I’ll leave it to you.”
“Understood.”

With that, my Father mounted Filolial-sama’s back and leaped onto the Spirit Tortoise’s back. After that, I continued deflecting the Spirit Tortoise’s breath attacks and crushing its head. I don’t know how long the Spirit Tortoise’s insides are, but I’ll just have to be patient until my Father and the others finish the job.
“Windmill X!”

And so the battle continued, until eventually the Spirit Tortoise came to a complete stop. My Father must have finished the job. Without hesitation, I blew the Spirit Tortoise’s head right off. With a thud, the Spirit Tortoise collapsed and fell to the ground.
“We did it!”
I cheered for my Father, who had fought inside the Spirit Turtle. With this, one of the threats has been eliminated. But… there’s no change in the hourglass in my field of vision, is there?

Hm? Is there a subtle change in the hourglass icon…? Or is it just my imagination? It looks as if something is being supplied from the hourglass marked with the number 8 to the one marked with the number 7. Is it just my imagination?
“We did it! Lord Motoyasu!”
Yuki-chan, Kou, and Filolial-sama rushed over to me to celebrate our victory.
“As expected of Lord Motoyasu and Lord Naofumi! Next up is the Phoenix, isn’t it?”
“That’s right. Or so I’d like to say, but things are looking a bit dicey.”
What could it be? I’m getting a strong, unpleasant premonition. That bad feeling became a reality ten minutes later. Suddenly, the Spirit Tortoise sprouted a head and came back to life.
“No way!”

In the first world, we were told that the Spirit Tortoise could be defeated by destroying both its heart and head at the same time. But there’s no time to hesitate. I resumed the battle, crushing the Spirit Tortoise’s head to buy some time. My Father must have sensed this, too, as he paused his movements from time to time.

At those moments, crushing the head did indeed stop its movements. However, ten minutes later, it would resume its activity once again. After repeating this cycle about four times, my Father and the others came down from the Spirit Tortoise’s back, bringing Sakura-chan with them.
“It’s no use. Motoyasu, even if we destroy the heart and head as planned, it comes back to life after a while.”
“Was there some discrepancy in our information?”

“I thought so too, so I did a little research in a certain part of the country on the Spirit Tortoise’s back, but I didn’t find anything noteworthy. Still, Motoyasu, did you see what happened with the hourglasses right after we defeated it?”
“Indeed. It looked as though the hourglass marked ‘8’ was sending something to the one marked ‘7.’”
“Yeah. Based on that… I’m starting to think the four Spirit Beasts whose seals have been broken might be linked.”

I can feel a cold sweat trickling down my forehead. To be honest, my Father is trying to explain something that’s incredibly complicated. And my gamer’s instinct tells me that what he’s about to say is probably correct.
“What do you mean?”
“Yeah. Probably… defeating the Spirit Tortoise and the Phoenix simultaneously is part of the plan.”
“What?…”
So that’s why the hourglasses looked connected. As I came to terms with this, a new problem surfaced. I felt as if the world was slowly growing dark before my eyes.

…Come to think of it, the Spirit Tortoise did use fire. I thought its breath attack was supposed to be lightning… And on top of that, the Phoenix uses fire. I should have realized something was off at that point. There’s a high probability that Father’s theory is correct.
“I’d say we have about ten minutes to defeat them. I think we’ll have to finish off the Phoenix within that time.”
“That’s quite a difficult challenge.”
“Yeah… it is. But we have to do it. So, let’s retreat for now and rethink our strategy.”
“Understood.”
I parried the Spirit Tortoise’s attacks to buy some time. And under my Father’s command, we were reluctantly… forced to retreat from the Spirit Tortoise.
